We need to apply the template (id 20810) to the given molecule (initial_molecule). The task: "return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_8_lvl1-template_search-1 to the molecule below". The template search result gave mapped_rxn and template_id 20810. So we need to apply that template to the molecule (SMILES given). Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles = initial_molecule, template_id = "20810". Then get list of precursor SMILES lists. Return list of lists.

Let's call apply_template.
